# Riju Dev Purkayastha

> Senior Software Engineer at Selegic India. Backend-focused full stack engineer who builds the backend that products run on and leads the team that ships it. Based in Kolkata, India.

Riju Dev Purkayastha (he/him). Location: Kolkata, India. Open to on-site, hybrid or remote. Looking for Senior or Lead Full Stack or Backend roles in Kolkata or Bengaluru. Email: rijudev12@gmail.com

## Projects

- [Selegic CRM](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/selegic-crm/): A multi-tenant CRM platform. I designed it, built v1 on my own and now lead the team that builds it.
- [Migrata](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/migrata/): Automated multi-org Salesforce data migration that replaced manual CPQ deployments with a repeatable, validated pipeline.
- [Selegic Internal](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/selegic-internal/): The company's time-tracking and project platform, built end to end.
- [Doc Gen](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/doc-gen/): Turns Salesforce records into DOCX and PDF from templates, via a web editor, a public API or a Salesforce quick action. I built it, including the Python and LibreOffice rendering service; with my team, PDF generation went from 12–13 s to about 1–2 s.
- [AttentaFit & Attenta Yoga](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/attenta-ios/): Native iOS fitness and wellness apps. I built most of AttentaFit's features in SwiftUI, and booking, players and sharing in Attenta Yoga, shipping builds 1.0.5 to 1.0.7.
- [Switch to Classic](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/switch-to-classic/): A Chrome extension that switches Salesforce between Lightning and Classic. I built it as an intern and maintained it for three years.
- [Remote Tooling](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/remote-tooling/): Tools for managing Salesforce field-level security and permission sets: Angular front ends and Node.js services.

## Work

- Selegic India: Senior Software Engineer, Jan 2022 to present. Backend-focused full stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, Hono, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers, React, TanStack, Prisma, Docker and GitHub Actions. Earlier work included native iOS apps in Swift and Salesforce tools in Angular and Node.js.
